description: List vouchers (sales invoices, receipts, payments, credit/debit notes) with pagination, date range, search, and optional JSON filters in the request body. Pass type, page, count, dates, sort, and search on the query string; send VoucherFilter fields in the JSON body. Part of the Get All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of vouchers per page). Default: 25. Optional.

from.description: Start of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Used with to. Optional.

to.description: End of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Used with from. Optional.

type.description: Which voucher list to load. Without a supported value the API returns no rows or INVALID_PARAMETER. Allowed values: sales, invoice, payment, receipt, credit note, debit note. Default: sales. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction for sortBy. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: voucherDate, dueDate, voucherNumber. Default: voucherDate. Optional.

invoiceCount.description: Related invoice count hint used for sales/invoice lists (backend default 10). Default: 10. Optional.

q.description: Case-sensitive search on account name, account uniqueName, or voucher number. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Limit to a branch. Omit for company default / consolidated behaviour. Optional.

voucherVersion.description: Use 2 for accounting-microservice voucher APIs (same as Giddh panel). Default: 2. Optional.

noteType.description: Credit/debit note subtype when type is a note list. Optional.

mail.description: When true, trigger mail export. Default: false. Optional.

accountUniqueName.description: Filter to a single customer/vendor account uniqueName. Optional.

balanceStatus.description: Filter by balance status. Send one or more values. Allowed values: PAID, UNPAID, PARTIALLY PAID, CANCEL, OVERDUE. Optional.

status.description: Filter by e-invoice / voucher status codes (when applicable for the type). Optional.

voucherNumber.description: Exact or partial voucher number filter. Optional.

balanceDue.description: Amount to compare when balanceMoreThan, balanceLessThan, or balanceEqual is true. Optional.

dueDate.description: Due date for dueDateBefore/After/Equal filters (dd-MM-yyyy). Optional.

balanceMoreThan.description: When true, balanceDue is a lower bound. Optional.

balanceLessThan.description: When true, balanceDue is an upper bound. Optional.

balanceEqual.description: When true, match exact balanceDue. Optional.

dueDateBefore.description: When true, dueDate is an upper bound. Optional.

dueDateAfter.description: When true, dueDate is a lower bound. Optional.

dueDateEqual.description: When true, match exact dueDate. Optional.

invoiceDateBefore.description: When true, invoiceDate is an upper bound. Optional.

invoiceDateAfter.description: When true, invoiceDate is a lower bound. Optional.

invoiceDateEqual.description: When true, match exact invoiceDate. Optional.

total.description: Grand total amount when totalMoreThan/LessThan/Equal flags are used. Optional.

totalMoreThan.description: Compare grand total greater than total. Optional.

totalLessThan.description: Compare grand total less than total. Optional.

totalEqual.description: Compare grand total equal to total. Optional.

groupUniqueName.description: Limit to accounts in this account group. Optional.

companyName.description: Optional company display name filter (export/report flows). Optional.

voucherUniqueNames.description: Fetch only these voucher uniqueNames (array). Optional.

copyTypes.description: Voucher copy types for export/mail flows. Allowed values: ORIGINAL, CUSTOMER, TRANSPORT. Optional.

sendTo.description: Email recipients when bulk export/mail is triggered from filter. Optional.
